This module builds the theory in four steps, each depending on the one before.

::: {.callout-tip}
## In this module
1. [Algebraic topology](algebraic-topology.qmd): simplicial complexes and homology
2. [Persistent homology](persistent-homology.qmd): homology across a filtration
3. [Stability](stability.qmd): why small changes in data give small changes in diagrams
4. [Vectorisation](vectorisation.qmd): turning diagrams into features for machine learning
:::
